A DHCP network needs room for clients: u.id: Jaringan DHCP memerlukan ruang untuk klien: gunakan /30 atau lebih besar.

This MAC address already has a lease abo.pl: Ten adres MAC ma już dzierżawę powyżej.

{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.es: {ip} está dentro del pool dinámico. RouterOS no se la dará a nadie más mientras exista el lease, pero mantener las direcciones estáticas fuera del pool es más fácil de leer.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.pt-BR: {ip} está dentro do pool dinâmico. O RouterOS não o entregará a mais ninguém enquanto o lease existir, mas manter os endereços estáticos fora do pool é mais fácil de ler.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.fr: {ip} est dans le pool dynamique. RouterOS ne la donnera à personne d'autre tant que le bail existe, mais garder les adresses statiques en dehors du pool est plus lisible.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.de: {ip} liegt im dynamischen Pool. RouterOS vergibt sie an niemand anderen, solange die Lease besteht, aber statische Adressen außerhalb des Pools zu halten ist übersichtlicher.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.id: {ip} berada di dalam pool dinamis. RouterOS tidak akan memberikannya ke siapa pun selama lease ada, tetapi menempatkan alamat statis di luar pool lebih mudah dibaca.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.it: {ip} si trova nel pool dinamico. RouterOS non lo assegnerà a nessun altro finché il lease esiste, ma tenere gli indirizzi statici fuori dal pool è più leggibile.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.tr: {ip} dinamik havuzun içinde. Kira sürdüğü sürece RouterOS bu adresi kimseye vermez, ancak statik adresleri havuzun dışında tutmak daha okunaklıdır.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.vi: {ip} nằm trong pool động. RouterOS sẽ không cấp địa chỉ này cho thiết bị khác khi lease còn tồn tại, nhưng để địa chỉ tĩnh nằm ngoài pool sẽ dễ đọc hơn.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.ru: {ip} входит в динамический пул. Пока аренда существует, RouterOS не выдаст его никому другому, но статические адреса удобнее держать вне пула.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.pl: {ip} leży w puli dynamicznej. RouterOS nie przydzieli go nikomu innemu, dopóki istnieje dzierżawa, ale łatwiej się orientować, gdy adresy statyczne są poza pulą.
{ip} is inside the dynamic pool. RouterO.hi: {ip} डायनामिक पूल के अंदर है। लीज़ रहने तक RouterOS इसे किसी और को नहीं देगा, लेकिन स्टैटिक पते पूल के बाहर रखना पढ़ने में आसान रहता है।

With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.es: Con allow-remote-requests=yes el router responde DNS en todas las interfaces. Asegúrate de que la cadena input descarte el DNS (puerto 53) de la WAN, o se convierte en un resolver abierto usado en ataques DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.pt-BR: Com allow-remote-requests=yes o roteador responde DNS em todas as interfaces. Garanta que a input chain descarte o DNS (porta 53) vindo da WAN, ou ele se torna um resolvedor aberto usado em ataques DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.fr: Avec allow-remote-requests=yes, le routeur répond au DNS sur toutes les interfaces. Assurez-vous que la chaîne input rejette le DNS (port 53) venant du WAN, sinon il devient un résolveur ouvert utilisé dans des attaques DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.de: Mit allow-remote-requests=yes beantwortet der Router DNS auf jedem Interface. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Input-Chain DNS (Port 53) aus dem WAN verwirft, sonst wird er zum offenen Resolver, der für DDoS-Angriffe genutzt wird.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.id: Dengan allow-remote-requests=yes router menjawab DNS di semua interface. Pastikan input chain men-drop DNS (port 53) dari WAN, atau ia menjadi resolver terbuka yang dipakai dalam serangan DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.it: Con allow-remote-requests=yes il router risponde alle richieste DNS su ogni interfaccia. Assicurati che la chain input blocchi il DNS (porta 53) dalla WAN, altrimenti diventa un resolver aperto usato negli attacchi DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.tr: allow-remote-requests=yes ile yönlendirici her arayüzde DNS yanıtlar. Input zinciri WAN'dan gelen DNS'i (port 53) düşürdüğünden emin olun; aksi halde DDoS saldırılarında kullanılan açık bir çözümleyiciye dönüşür.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.vi: Với allow-remote-requests=yes, router trả lời DNS trên mọi giao diện. Hãy đảm bảo chuỗi input chặn DNS (cổng 53) từ WAN, nếu không router sẽ trở thành resolver mở bị lợi dụng trong các cuộc tấn công DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.ru: При allow-remote-requests=yes маршрутизатор отвечает на DNS-запросы на всех интерфейсах. Убедитесь, что цепочка input отбрасывает DNS (порт 53) из WAN, иначе он станет открытым резолвером, который используют для DDoS-атак.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.pl: Przy allow-remote-requests=yes router odpowiada na zapytania DNS na każdym interfejsie. Upewnij się, że łańcuch input odrzuca DNS (port 53) z WAN, bo inaczej router stanie się otwartym resolwerem wykorzystywanym w atakach DDoS.
With allow-remote-requests=yes the route.hi: allow-remote-requests=yes होने पर राउटर हर इंटरफ़ेस पर DNS का जवाब देता है। पक्का करें कि input चेन WAN से आने वाला DNS (पोर्ट 53) ड्रॉप करती हो, वरना यह ओपन रिज़ॉल्वर बन जाता है, जिसका इस्तेमाल DDoS हमलों में होता है।

The router resolves DNS, but clients are.es: El router resuelve DNS, pero a los clientes se les indica que usen otros servidores. Agrega {ip} a los servidores DNS si deben usar el router.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.pt-BR: O roteador resolve DNS, mas os clientes são orientados a usar outros servidores. Adicione {ip} aos servidores DNS se eles devem usar o roteador.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.fr: Le routeur résout le DNS, mais il est indiqué aux clients d'utiliser d'autres serveurs. Ajoutez {ip} aux serveurs DNS s'ils doivent utiliser le routeur.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.de: Der Router löst DNS auf, aber den Clients werden andere Server genannt. Fügen Sie {ip} zu den DNS-Servern hinzu, wenn sie den Router nutzen sollen.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.id: Router me-resolve DNS, tetapi klien diberi tahu untuk memakai server lain. Tambahkan {ip} ke server DNS jika mereka harus memakai router.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.it: Il router risolve il DNS, ma ai client viene indicato di usare altri server. Aggiungi {ip} ai server DNS se devono usare il router.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.tr: Yönlendirici DNS çözümlüyor ancak istemcilere başka sunucuları kullanmaları söyleniyor. İstemciler yönlendiriciyi kullansın istiyorsanız {ip} adresini DNS sunucularına ekleyin.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.vi: Router phân giải DNS, nhưng máy khách được yêu cầu dùng máy chủ khác. Hãy thêm {ip} vào danh sách máy chủ DNS nếu muốn máy khách dùng router.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.ru: Маршрутизатор разрешает DNS, но клиентам сообщают другие серверы. Добавьте {ip} в DNS-серверы, если клиенты должны использовать маршрутизатор.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.pl: Router rozwiązuje nazwy DNS, ale klientom podano inne serwery. Dodaj {ip} do serwerów DNS, jeśli klienci mają używać routera.
The router resolves DNS, but clients are.hi: राउटर DNS रिज़ॉल्व करता है, लेकिन क्लाइंट को दूसरे सर्वर इस्तेमाल करने को कहा गया है। अगर क्लाइंट राउटर को इस्तेमाल करें, तो DNS सर्वर में {ip} जोड़ें।

The pool has only {n} addresses..fr: Le pool ne contient que {n} adresses.
The pool has only {n} addresses..pl: Pula ma za mało adresów: tylko {n}.

An interface can have only one DHCP serv.es: Una interfaz solo puede tener un servidor DHCP. Si {iface} ya tiene uno, elimínalo o cámbialo en lugar de agregar este.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.pt-BR: Uma interface só pode ter um servidor DHCP. Se {iface} já tem um, remova-o ou altere-o em vez de adicionar este.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.fr: Une interface ne peut avoir qu'un seul serveur DHCP. Si {iface} en a déjà un, supprimez-le ou modifiez-le au lieu d'ajouter celui-ci.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.de: Ein Interface kann nur einen DHCP-Server haben. Hat {iface} schon einen, entfernen oder ändern Sie ihn, statt diesen hinzuzufügen.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.id: Satu interface hanya bisa punya satu DHCP server. Jika {iface} sudah punya, hapus atau ubah yang itu, jangan menambahkan yang ini.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.it: Un'interfaccia può avere un solo server DHCP. Se {iface} ne ha già uno, rimuovilo o modificalo invece di aggiungere questo.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.tr: Bir arayüzde yalnızca bir DHCP sunucusu olabilir. {iface} üzerinde zaten varsa bunu eklemek yerine mevcut olanı kaldırın veya değiştirin.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.vi: Một giao diện chỉ có thể có một máy chủ DHCP. Nếu {iface} đã có, hãy xóa hoặc sửa nó thay vì thêm máy chủ này.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.ru: На интерфейсе может быть только один DHCP-сервер. Если на {iface} он уже есть, удалите или измените его, а не добавляйте этот.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.pl: Interfejs może mieć tylko jeden serwer DHCP. Jeśli {iface} już go ma, usuń go lub zmień zamiast dodawać nowy.
An interface can have only one DHCP serv.hi: एक इंटरफ़ेस पर सिर्फ़ एक DHCP सर्वर हो सकता है। अगर {iface} पर पहले से एक है, तो इसे जोड़ने की जगह उसे हटाएँ या बदलें।
